value: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) retailing and fitting prescription eyeglasses and contact lenses; (2) retailing prescription eyeglasses in combination with the grinding of lenses to order on the premises; and (3) retailing nonprescription eyeglasses.
Lens grinding, ophthalmic, in retail stores
Optical goods stores (except offices of optometrists, ophthalmologists)
